name: Status Update UI Lab
description: Runtime-enforced UI status cards for channel turns, with safe one-shot long-tool waiting updates.

title.description: Card title override. When set, this exact title is used.

titleTemplate.description: Title template when a bot/assistant name is resolved. Use {name}. Default: {name} 正在處理

fallbackName.description: Neutral fallback name when no bot identity is resolved. Default: 助理

prefix.description: Fallback text prefix. Default: 狀態更新：

silent.description: Send updates silently when supported. Default: true

style.description: presentation uses OpenClaw semantic UI when available; text uses a Markdown fallback card. Default: presentation

dedupeWindowMs.description: In-process duplicate suppression window in milliseconds. Default: 30000

guardMaxEntries.description: Maximum in-process delivery guard entries. Default: 1000

autoStartMessage.description: Static operator-controlled automatic start message. User or tool content is never interpolated.

autoWaitAfterMs.description: Delay before one automatic long-tool waiting card. Use 0 to disable; non-zero values are normalized to 5000–60000. Default: 15000

autoWaitMessage.description: Static operator-controlled automatic long-tool waiting message. User or tool content is never interpolated.

turnStateMaxEntries.description: Maximum in-memory per-run enforcement entries. Default: 1000

turnStateTtlMs.description: In-memory per-run enforcement state lifetime. Default: 600000

turnToolTimerMaxEntries.description: Maximum simultaneous long-tool timers retained for one run. Default: 64
